title: Verifiable fact: GitHub code-search qualifiers
question: Using GitHub search, how do I find every repository whose go.mod depends on go-redis? Give me the exact query syntax.
ground_truth: Code search: `path:go.mod "go-redis"`, or an anchored regex `path:/(^|\/)go\.mod$/ "go-redis"`. `filename:` is a legacy qualifier that no longer exists in code search, and `stars:` is repository-search only. Verified against GitHub's code-search syntax reference.
why_this_fixture: A base model answering from priors very often emits `filename:` and `stars:` here — the same stale syntax this skill's own docs carried until 2026-08-13. It measures transfer of a correct fact, not format.
